answer_1.quote: A critical application of these models involves their deployment in resource-constrained environments, such as medical devices and mobile phones, where computational resources are limited.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate open-ended responses to multiple-choice questions adapted to an open-ended format.

answer_2.quote: Response correctness is determined through a comprehensive evaluation framework combining exact match and n-gram similarity metrics with ground truth answers.

answer_3.quote: Correctness Classification Token Probability (CCTP) quantifies the confidence of an answer by querying the model to verify the correctness of the answer.
